decisions.rationale: 6 days in with no first project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero tickets. Two Wrenfield emails (email:51c4cc55, email:a15dc51a) went unanswered, showing no engagement signal. Pro plan and 8 days left leave some chance of self-serve activation, but silence suggests low unaided odds.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Theo,

Following up on my last note. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so getting one real project in is usually the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project if that's easiest.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through it with you and answer anything else about Clearwater Labs' setup.

Best,
Nadia
